captions.FB: Learning to cook differently is one of the four pillars at the Bariatric Counseling Center. Our head chef, Leila Bebley, teaches culinary classes in our state-of-the-art teaching kitchen, where clients practice recipe education and instruction alongside behavioral therapy, dietary guidance and mindful movement. One program, not four. Serving clients both onsite in San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Link in the first comment.
captions.IG:
Learning to cook differently

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, culinary classes are one of the four pillars of our innovative program designed to help people who struggle with weight loss, obesity, binge eating and chronic overeating. Our head chef, Leila Bebley, teaches recipe education and instruction in our state-of-the-art teaching kitchen. We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and mindful eating education in a unique, all-inclusive format. One program, not four. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BariatricCounseling #SanAntonio #MindfulRecovery
